watch_interval.description: Watch interval in seconds (allowing fractional values, e.g., 0.2 for ping, 0.5 for cmd)

buffer.description: Number of seconds to display in the graph

ipv4_only.description: Resolve ping targets to IPv4 addresses only

ipv6_only.description: Resolve ping targets to IPv6 addresses only

interface.description: Network interface to use when pinging

simple_graphics.description: Use dot characters instead of braille characters for the graph

vertical_margin.description: Vertical margin (top and bottom) around the graph

horizontal_margin.description: Horizontal margin (left and right) around the graph

command_mode.description: Graph execution time for commands instead of pinging hosts

colors.description: List of colors (hex #RRGGBB or names like 'red', 'blue') assigned per host/command in order

hosts.description: List of hosts to ping or commands to execute (if command_mode is true)
